question: Used as the VN-style synthetic source of train2's pretraining mixture, does synth3 lower real-screenshot CER on the development cohort compared with synth2, at a fixed architecture, recipe, step count and seed?

recipe.note: train2's pretraining recipe (docs/train2.md) at 16,000 instead of 32,000-40,000 steps

nv.note: nvsynth's one-line-per-page set (docs/nvsynth.md). train2's every-line set (nvsynth/full) was deleted from the shared disk on 2026-10-12 09:48Z by a disk clean-up, so every arm uses this set instead.

s3.note: pinned by data/manifests/synth3_shards_v2.json (generator version 2), committed before the first synth3 arm trains; see amendments

checkpoint: ckpt_step16000.pt of every run (EMA weights). No checkpoint selection: the in-training teacher_val evaluations are logged for monitoring only.

dev.note: train2's selection set: no VN, release or screenshot shared with any training pool or with eval's test sets; synth3 excluded all of its VNs from names and scenes

metric: CER (eval/metrics.norm both sides, Levenshtein over reference characters) over all development lines, both views, errors summed over the arm's two seeds
decision: For each comparison X_vs_Y, Y is better than X iff the VN-cluster 95% interval of CER(Y) - CER(X) lies entirely below 0 and CER(Y) - CER(X) < 0 for each seed pair. Recommended VN-style synthetic data: synth3 if B beats A and C does not beat B; the mix if C beats both A and B; otherwise synth2 stays and the result is reported as no measured improvement.
reported_not_decided: every stratum of eval/synth3_ablation.py (target, kind, polarity, ink height, length, name-like, dakuten/small kana, rare kanji, Latin/digits) with intervals
per-VN better/worse counts and the largest per-VN regressions (no per-VN veto)
the in-training teacher_val and synthetic validation curves

amendments.change: s3 now points to the version-2 render (data/manifests/synth3_shards_v2.json, shards/train_v2) instead of the version-1 render (data/manifests/synth3_shards_20261012.json).
amendments.reason: The teacher-agreement label audit (synth/synth3_audit.py, 1,500 crops) found version-1 crops holding unlabelled text: real screen text from scene screenshots merged into GRAD boxes, and gt boxes widened across a neighbouring line. Metadata over 100,000 version-1 crops: 2.8% of gt crops have an ink box much wider than their label and 4.8% of GRAD crops are over 2.2x their ink height. Version 2 cuts scenes only from screenshots with known text boxes and avoids those boxes, measures each line's ink columns inside its own glyph extent, and keeps a GRAD box only when it holds and hugs exactly one labelled line.
amendments.runs_affected: A_s2, B_s3 and C_mix seed 1 were stopped by the owner at 13:25Z (machine move) after 9,600 / 1,500 / 1,400 steps; none was exported or scored. All six primary runs restart from scratch on the new machine.
